item.title: Thunderstorm Advisory No. 4 #SLPRSD
item.description:
Thunderstorm Advisory No. 4 #SLPRSD
Issued at 09:30 AM 18 November 2026

Moderate to occasionally heavy rainshowers with lightning and strong winds are expected over #Masbate(Monreal, Aroroy and Baleno) within the next 1 to 2 hours.

The above conditions are being experienced in #Albay(Daraga, Camalig, Jovellar), #Masbate(Claveria), #Sorsogon(Donsol and Pilar) which may persist within 1 to 2 hours and may affect nearby areas.

All are advised to take precautionary measures against the impacts associated with these hazards which include flash floods and landslides.

Keep monitoring for updates.
